zero_failure_boundaries: A zero-length prefix deliberately suspends; it is not cachedRunFuel 0, which fails exhaustedFuel when the guard remains true.
After exactly maxSplits successful steps, a prefix may be suspended at the budget boundary; final resume 0 performs the original zero-fuel stop decision.
Every error branch retains the pre-step full state and exact DriverFailure; every early belowTarget/budget terminal keeps its entire Result.
A prefix length does not by itself prove the final split counter or successful completion; early termination/failure remains possible.
Every chunk uses the same nodes and fixed value; preserving only sum/count or a heap permutation is not the equality asserted by hp.
